# Pull Request Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance or CI

## Implementation details

Explain the important implementation choices and any trade-offs.

## Validation

- [ ] JavaScript syntax check passed.
- [ ] HTML validation passed.
- [ ] Search behavior was tested where applicable.
- [ ] Empty, error, and pagination states were considered.
- [ ] Keyboard and responsive behavior were reviewed.
- [ ] No credentials or private configuration were committed.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog were updated where needed.

## Screenshots

Add screenshots for visible UI changes.

## Risks and follow-up

List known limitations, migration steps, or follow-up work.
